# Aire

> Nicotine-free, caffeine-free wellness pouches for calm, clarity, and stress
> resilience. Made by Drifts LLC, New York, NY, United States.

Aire is an oral pouch placed between the upper lip and gum for up to 60 minutes.
It contains no nicotine and no caffeine, and is non-habit-forming. Aire is a
dietary supplement, not a nicotine replacement therapy or cessation product.
Statements about its ingredients are structure/function claims and have not been
evaluated by the FDA.

Four active ingredients per pouch: L-Theanine, Rhodiola Rosea, Saffron
(Affron(R)), and L-Tyrosine. Note that only Rhodiola Rosea is an adaptogen;
L-Theanine and L-Tyrosine are amino acids and saffron is a botanical extract.

Format: 15 pouches per can, 4 cans per pack (60 pouches). Flavor: Calm Mint.
Price: $45.99 USD per 4-pack. Free shipping on US orders over $50. US shipping only.
